\tabnotes{Each cell reports the pooled out-of-sample statistic $R^{2}_{\mathrm{oos}}$ of the
  fully-recursive factor forecast against the recursive prevailing mean,
  scored over the country-months whose forecast origin lies in the indicated
  window, with squared errors aggregated across the G10 and each country
  scored against its own recursive mean. A positive value means the factor
  beats the real-time historical average. Both the factor and the predictive
  regression respect time $t$, so the exercise is doubly out of sample. All
  four factors share a five-year training minimum, so every window carries
  real-time forecasts. Specifications and subsample definitions as in
  \Cref{tab:rob-sub-is}.}
